newsitem.title: BULGARIA: EBRD to invest in United Bulgarian Bank.
newsitem.headline: EBRD to invest in United Bulgarian Bank.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) plans to invest in the United Bulgarian Bank (UBB) as part of its support for the ailing banking sector, a central bank official said on Tuesday.
"The EBRD plans to participate in the UBB privatisation with some 24.3 million European Currency Units (ECU), according to preliminary talks," said the official, who declined to be named.
Under an initial project launched two years ago, the EBRD was expected to invest up to $100 million in the UBB but nothing was settled.
EBRD representatives visited Sofia last month to discuss the privatisation deal with Bulgarian authorities.
The EBRD is expected to share its participation with another investor, the official said.
UBB figures showed its capital to risk assets ratio stood at above five percent at the end of September.
UBB boosted is capital with $119 million worth of government bonds as part of a bank stabilisation scheme launched in June.

"The EBRD will focus on the completion and implementation of the privatisation and recapitalisation of the United Bulgarian Bank," said the EBRD in a statement presenting its revised strategy for Bulgaria.
